snapshot.text: Public Ministry of Health network alongside the social security institute ISSS. The government is investing in hospitals and telemedicine through the Doctor SV platform.

priorities.title: Hospital budgets
priorities.text: US$634.9 million distributed across 30 public hospitals.

priorities.title: Telemedicine
priorities.text: Digitalisation and telemedicine reduced in-person visits at health units by more than 168,000.
